name: comp-583
title: Breadcrumb Project Header
description: A slim dark header with a breadcrumb trail from logo through Personal Account and Projects to a project switcher button, plus a notification bell and user avatar.
use: A workspace app needs to show where you are and let you switch project from the top bar.
avoid: Only two projects are listed and the trail is fixed to account and projects, so deeper paths need new markup.
a11y: The project select and breadcrumb are labelled, but the logo link has no accessible name. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A slim dark header holds a breadcrumb: starburst logo, slash, Personal Account, slash, Projects, slash, then a ghost button with the current project name and an up-down chevron. A bell with a dot and a round avatar sit at the far right.
behaves: Hovering a breadcrumb link underlines it. The project button opens a small dropdown naming the projects with a tick on the current one; choosing another swaps the label and closes the list.
customise: The breadcrumb trail and the two project names are written in the file; the notification and user menus come from separate pieces.
weight: light: A breadcrumb, one select and two small buttons.
